deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.16.2 -> canary-usw2. staged ramp: 1% -> 10% over 10m. kicking off post-deploy smoke suite (synths, kvprobe, healthchecks). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/2934567890 :rocket:
maya: FYI synth probe for /chat-streaming shows quality regression (few hallucinations) in the canary sample at ~2934567908. content check failing golden prompts. :warning:
trent: can you paste the failing synth outputs?
maya: snippets: ```
[2934567906] prompt: "Summarize meeting notes" -> response: "The user asked about pricing and we built a spaceship" (golden expected: concise bullets)
[2934567908] prompt: "Short summary" -> response contained hallucinated dates and made-up names
```
hao: that's concerning. is it model-behavioral (decode config) or perf-related? any 5xxs or timeouts?
maya: no 5xxs, latency fine. kvprobe and kernel metrics look normal. seems like sampling/decoding changes in v2.16.2 for chat-model defaults (release notes mention "sampling temperature tweak for safety heuristics").
replay-bot: automated repro runner flagged 3/20 golden prompts failing the quality gate in canary. threshold is 2/20. incident candidate: synth-quality-regression (severity: medium).
trent: recommend PAUSE ramp to 1% and pin /chat-streaming to stable v2.16.0 until triage. we should avoid full rollback yet.
maya: agree. reducing ramp and pinning now. command: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /chat-streaming --version v2.16.0 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy quality gate fail"```
deploy-bot: routing change applied by maya at 2934567918. audit id r-audit-11001. canary traffic reduced to 1% for chat-streaming.
hao: I'll pull model config diffs and sampling params, and run local reproducer against v2.16.2. assign to @infra-team to check if any decode-time optimizations hit during canary.
trent: I'll update release notes and open ticket RINF-7890 "v2.16.2 sampling default regression on chat models" with traces and failing golden prompts. link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/RINF-7890
maya: action items: maya monitor quality gate for 30m, hao gather diffs & repro logs, trent create ticket & notes, infra-team investigate decode/runtime diffs. escalate to full rollback if quality gate breach reaches 5/20 or if other routes see similar regression.
replay-bot: scheduled 10m recheck of golden prompts.
maya: 5m update: repro runner still failing 3/20 on canary, stable tests passing. leaving thread open for triage. :white_check_mark:
